high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from "The New Indian Express," a news website. The top of the page displays the website's logo, which includes a red circular emblem with an emblematic design and the text "THE NEW INDIAN EXPRESS" in bold black letters. Below the logo, there is a navigation bar with several categories: NATION, WORLD, STATES (with a dropdown arrow indicating more options), OPINIONS, CITIES (with a dropdown arrow), BUSINESS, SPORT (with a dropdown arrow), and GOOD NEWS. There is also a moon icon on the far right, likely for switching between day and night
